data.comment:
# Comfy Vidu Q4 Preview- Image to Video

Generate cinematic videos from a single still image using Vidu Q4 Preview, an expressive flagship model built for lifelike character acting, dramatic camera movement, and striking visual effects. Submit 1 image and receive 1 finished video, with support for up to 15 reference images, 3 reference audio clips, and 2K or 4K output. Ideal for short films, marketing content, and social media storytelling. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_vidu_q4_preview_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt:
5-second image-to-video luxury fashion editorial. Use the uploaded image as the exact first frame. Keep the same model’s face, short hair, shimmering teal suit, yellow shirt and yellow boots consistent across every cut. Preserve the curved white concrete wall, deep blue sky, strong sunlight and sharp architectural shadows.
Create a rapid sequence of distinct hard cuts, not smooth transitions:
0–0.6s: Start from the original dramatic worm’s-eye view; the model looks down toward the lens.
0.6–1.3s: Hard cut to a straight-down overhead full-body shot. The model pivots, creating a bold graphic shape against the white concrete.
1.3–1.9s: Hard cut to an eye-level side profile; the model turns sharply toward camera.
1.9–2.6s: Hard cut to a low-angle medium shot, framing the teal jacket against the blue sky.
2.6–3.2s: Hard cut to a tight frontal portrait with a quick push-in as the model meets the lens.
3.2–4.0s: Hard cut to a wide, slightly tilted architectural shot; the model takes one confident step and strikes a new pose.
4.0–5.0s: Two quick cuts between an overhead view and a powerful low-angle full-body view. Finish on a brief, perfectly composed fashion-photo freeze.
Crisp editorial pacing, striking changes in camera height and shot size, confident restrained posing, saturated teal-yellow-blue color blocking, premium campaign photography. Each cut reveals a new angle of the same outfit and location. No shoe-sole close-up, no slow orbit, no dissolve, no identity drift, no outfit changes, no text or watermark.
